thread:
Alyssa: Kicked off a segmented proxy ratecap experiment this morning to isolate noisy-tenant bursts. Noticed p99 token latencies on shared pools spike when a few heavy tenants burst at once.
Ben: Nice. Quick summary of the change?
Alyssa: We added per-segment token buckets at the proxy layer (segment = tenancy shard). Two-tier caps: soft per-tenant, and hard per-segment. Soft is permissive with short smoothing, hard drops to dedicated fallback routing when exceeded.
Cheng: Any config snippet? want to see enforcement logic.
Alyssa: Sure, posted the gate config we deployed to the proxy canary: ```
segment_id: tenant_shard
ratelimit:
  soft: {rate: 2000, burst: 300}
  hard: {rate: 5000, burst: 500}
fallback:
  action: route_to_dedicated_if_hard_exceeded
```
Marta: Curious about KV cache cold starts when we bounce traffic to Dedicated — this will impact both latency and cost for warmups. Did you add a warmup window?
Alyssa: We did a 30s grace period before triggering the hard fallback to avoid flapping. The dedicated route has a cache-warming hint header so serving runtime will prefetch last keys for that tenant when allowed.
Samir: How are we calculating cost impact for dedicated fallback? need to update showback tagging so billing isn't surprising.
Marta: I can add a temporary tag on fallback routes (tag:fallback-experiment) so Optimize and Console can break out the delta. Will also create a dashboard panel for extra GPU-minutes.
Ben: Metrics so far? p99 drop? p50?
Alyssa: Canary (eu-west-2 small pool) shows p99 reduced from 820ms -> 420ms for mixed-run; p50 unchanged. Token throughput for shared pool reduced ~12%, dedicated used ~3% extra capacity but mostly idle after warmup.
Cheng: 3% extra cap seems acceptable if it prevents tail spikes. But watch out for tenant affinity imbalance — some shards map to single racks. We should randomize shard->pool mapping or we'll create hotspots.
Alyssa: Agreed. Current mapping is static. Plan: add jittered assignment on deploy and a short drain window to move active connections gradually.
Samir: What's the rollback plan if dedicated capacity saturates?
Alyssa: Fallback policy includes a tiered degrade: (1) if dedicated pool usage > 85% for 30s, reduce soft limits globally by 20% for 2 minutes; (2) if >95%, route lowest-priority tenants to best-effort pool (no cache, lowest concurrency).
Ben: Can we simulate that in staging? loadgen with 10 heavy tenants hitting same shard?
Cheng: I can run a mixed-workload sim this afternoon. Will also test cross-az failover — we need to ensure routing respects region constraints and data residency flags.
Marta: FYI I'll add a note in Console that these requests may show as fallback tag for cost. Also posting a short blurb on the runbook so SREs know how to interpret the new metrics.
ops-bot: Deploy 1834567888 by alyssa/proxy-ratecap to canary eu-west-2 succeeded :white_check_mark:
Samir: Good. Can we gate on a small set of tenants first? maybe customers with known noisy patterns (prod123, analytics-team)?
Alyssa: Yes starting with a 5-tenant pilot, opt-in flag in tenant config. Will post list.
Ben: One more ask — add tracing spans for "ratecheck.segment" so we can see where time is spent (proxy, route decision, downstream).
Alyssa: Will add. Also adding an alert: sustained p99 > 700ms for shared pool while dedicated contended triggers immediate rollback.
Cheng: Sounds solid. After sim and pilot, we should evaluate if we can move some of this logic into the serving runtime (lower hop) for lower latency. But proxy-level gives faster rollout.
Marta: Thanks — I'll handle cost tagging and dashboard. Samir, can you shepherd the pilot list?
Samir: Yep. I'll DM tenant owners for opt-in.
Ben: :thumbsup: keep us posted in this thread with any anomalies.
Alyssa: Will do. If anyone sees unexpected spikes in dedicated pool, tag me @Alyssa.
ops-bot: Alert: eu-west-2-dedicated-pool GPU-util 86% (1m avg) — threshold breach.
Alyssa: Noted, starting temporary global soft-limit reduction now. (react:thumbsup)
Cheng: I'll pause the staging sim to avoid compounding.
Marta: Dashboard shows warmups finished for the 5 pilot tenants, latency improving.
Ben: Great work team. We'll reconvene tomorrow with post-pilot numbers. :rocket:
